notes:
Top-line: large internal engineering org building a developer-facing code search + RAG layer. Primary ask: scalable embeddings store with low-latency reranking and frequent re-indexing.

Key quotes / call shorthands:
- Eng lead: "We have ~25M source vectors today, growing 30% qtrly; nightly deltas can't take longer than 2 hours."
- Security: "Must SSO via SAML, keys in our KMS, and audit logs retained 7yrs for compliance."
- PM: "Cost target: <$0.002 per query at 95th percentile for our typical search traffic."

What we've done so far:
- NDA signed 2025-11-10.
- Initial infra scoping call w/ Jordan (SE) 2026-01-12 (ff_20260112_arch).
- Demo of Redwood Dedicated (model routing + KV caching) 2026-02-14 (ff_20260214_odin_poc_demo).
- Security deep-dive with Priya and security ops 2026-03-02 (ff_20260302_security_call).

Technical constraints / asks (CRM shorthand):
- Index scale: ~25M vectors, expected to hit ~100M in 12-18 months.
- Vector dim: 1536 (custom encoder), storage must support mixed-precision quantized vectors.
- Re-index cadence: incremental deltas every 30m, nightly full compact + weekly full rebuild.
- Latency SLO: 95p end-to-end search + rerank < 150ms (target), p99 < 400ms for production queries.
- Throughput: baseline 150 qps, peak bursts to 1k qps during dev deploy windows.
- Reranking pattern: sparse retrieval (ANN top-K=200) then cross-encoder rerank on top-20; cross-encoder budget ~10-20ms per query on dedicated instances.
- Cost target: average per-query cost <$0.002 including retrieval + rerank; team expects Redwood Optimize recommendations to reduce by 30% vs naive setup.
- Data residency: primary region US-East, backup EU for GDPR-sensitive subsets.

Security / compliance notes:
- Requires SSO via SAML + SCIM for user provisioning.
- Keys must be stored in their on-prem HSM or cloud KMS (customer-managed).
- Audit logs must be exportable and shipped to their SIEM.

POC scope discussed:
- 30-day POC: import 25M vectors (sample), verify incremental ingestion <2hr, run 72hr throughput/stress, validate rerank accuracy and latency under load.
- Provide cost model extrapolated to 100M vectors and 1k qps bursts.
- Show fallback routing: dedicated -> hosted cheap variant during maintenance windows.

Commercial / procurement notes:
- Procurement prefers annual committed capacity for Dedicated with overage pricing.
- Legal flagged data residency addendum and encryption clause.
- Budget earmarked but SLA/DSA negotiation needed before final PO.

Next tangible actions (short):
- Exchange SAML metadata (owner: Odin infra) — pending cert.
- Deliver POC node sizing doc + cost delta sheet by 2026-03-15 (owner: Jordan).
- Run ingestion dry-run with 5M vectors to validate delta pipeline 2026-03-18.

CRM-style loose notes (for AE):
- Customer is highly engineering-driven; use technical ROI (cost/token, latency benefits) not product marketing.
- Recommend a joint runbook: reindex playbook + incident escalation map.
- Watch competitor concern: they are evaluating Elastic Cloud + Pinecone for embedding infra; Elastic favored for integrated search but Redwood differentiates on model-aware routing and rerank integration.
